runtimePersistence: model_stream_progress current attempt and run fence; monotonic sequence; no reopening terminal phase
cardOutput: fixed policy status strings/counts, never unverified model body
providerProtocol: native GLM SSE parser, incomplete turns are not journaled or executed
retry: fresh progress attempt after durable retry; unknown card response is not resent
finalization: one accepted isFinalize update; FINALIZED_UNVERIFIED remains unverified delivery
rateLimit: Respect full delta-seconds or HTTP-date Retry-After; no60-second cap; suppress when deadline exceeds task expiry
